concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-marketplaces-payout-webhooks]] — 2023-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Marketplace bank-payout Transfer webhook guide for request/reservation/booking versus bank tracking, credit, failure and return; includes insufficient-balance and blocked-bank-account limits.
warnings: Booked balance debit and ETA/tracing are not beneficiary receipt (raw lines 325–334, 830–836, 950–974).
Permanent-return issues can block new transfer requests with HTTP 422; the reason table's retry suggestions do not establish a universal safe retry (raw lines 1349–1355, 1532–1547).
